note: Issue #611: rules every race shares. Read by src/systems/racing/race_crew.gd. line_up_reach: how close to the grid (m) your speeder must be for [Z]. countdown_s: seconds per count (3, 2, 1, GO). grid_timeout_s: racers still driving to the grid this long after you line up are set on their slots. beep / go_sound: Sound keys (content/look/sound.json). crowd_profiles: the soldier profiles spectators are drawn from (random local looks). crowd_band: where they stand, beside the start line, [min, max] metres out from each antenna and [min, max] metres behind the line. return_s: after the race, how long the racers have to drive back and park before their speeders are put away. collect: Dorrin's prompt for your winnings. Issue #616: seeker_chance_s and mine_chance_s, a racer's chance each second (while it may fight) of firing a seeker at you in its nose or dropping a mine with you within mine_behind_m behind it. hud: the race HUD's words.
